Name: Plump Krobus Sprite (CP)
Author: KimmJoja
Description:
[center][b]Krobus is slimy and adorable, but he'd definitely be just as adorable if he were more plump!
[/b]
[size=2]크로버스는 흐물흐물해서 귀엽지만, 조금 더 탱글탱글해져도 분명 똑같이 귀여울 거예요!
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/vxsnVWTG/Kakao-Talk-20251117-053133240-02.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
This mod replaces Krobus's sprites using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
There are two types of sprites, and you can select the type using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu(GMCM)[/url].

[size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]를 통해 크로버스의 스프라이트를 교체하는 모드입니다.
두 타입의 스프라이트가 있으며, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM 메뉴[/url]에서 타입을 선택할 수 있습니다.
[/size]
